title.narrative: Improving the Lives of People in Off-Grid Communities in Mindanao through the Provision of Sustainable Energy

description.narrative: The project will address the energy poverty situation in 10 provinces in Mindanao by improving the quality of life of 5,120 marginalized households through provision of clean,sufficient and sustainable energy for 58 off-grid communities via micro/pico -hydropower and solar energy systems.The project will also develop local capacities and promote multi-stakeholders partnership involving the community, local government units and other key players in the energy and community development sectors
